channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Darko Rajakovic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Darko Rajakovic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Darko Rajakovic
item.description:
“I feel good (but) being smart, taking it slow, just getting familiar with everybody, getting their names right with each coach, (the) player development guys, learning the plays and, yeah, just learning everything that (head coach Darko Rajakovic) has been doing the past three or four years,”

Kawhi Leonard on Darko Rajakovic, Oct 7, 2026. Source: SportsNet.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Darko Rajakovic
item.description:
Ujiri on picking up Rajakovic's 4th year option before the season:

“I think it's the right thing to do but more than that it was deserving... He's done a phenomenal job. We've put him in a tough position... It's good to make him feel comfortable with his job and where he is.”

Masai Ujiri on Darko Rajakovic, Apr 16, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Darko Rajakovic, Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes
item.description:
“And also, I just felt that I needed a fresh start. A fresh start somewhere where guys played hard and they listened. I heard good things about Scottie [Barnes], I heard good things about [Immanuel] Quickley and I thought it was a good fit offensively and defensively. And Darko [Rajakovic] had a part in that too.”

Brandon Ingram on Darko Rajakovic, Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes, Feb 13, 2025. Source: TSN.

item.title: RJ Barrett on Darko Rajakovic
item.description:
Barrett on Rajakovic:

“I’ve gotten so close to Darko. He’s a coach that you can just talk to, honestly, about anything. A lot of our conversations sometimes have nothing to do with basketball. He checks on me a lot, for sure. I appreciate him in more than just a basketball sense”

RJ Barrett on Darko Rajakovic, Apr 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Darko Rajakovic
item.description:
CoachGregg Popovich on former Spurs scout/summer league coach Darko Rajakovic:

“Darko is great. He is one of those under the radar kind of guys. He doesn't seek attention or anything like that. But he has a really brilliant mind … I’m really pulling for him.”

Gregg Popovich on Darko Rajakovic, Nov 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @michaelgrange.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Darko Rajakovic
item.description:
Nikola Jokić on Darko Rajakovic being hired as the new Toronto Raptors head coach:

“I think it’s a lot of respect for him and for his work, and I think he deserves it…I think he’s going to do a great job there.”

Nikola Jokic on Darko Rajakovic, Jun 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.
